meta.prompt: Show the change you want to make to my config.yaml as a diff I can review, in three separate hunks with line numbers, removed lines red and added lines green in a monospace font. Hunk 1 (Server port, lines 4 to 5): -port: 8080 +port: 9090. Hunk 2 (Logging, lines 12 to 15): -level: debug -file: /tmp/app.log +level: warn +file: /var/log/app.log. Hunk 3 (Cache, lines 20 to 22): +enabled: true +ttl: 300. Keep and Discard buttons on each hunk, a count of how many are decided and how many kept, and an Apply button that only works once all three are decided; after Apply the card says how many hunks were kept and how many discarded.
meta.text:
I'll write the notation directly, using DiffHunk for each hunk and a text variable per hunk to track its decision.

state h1=""
state h2=""
state h3=""
state applied=false
state kept=0
state discarded=0
ChatCard "config.yaml" "3 changes to review" icon:"description" status:"Review" w:390
  DiffHunk "Server port" "@@ -4,2 +4,2 @@" =h1 start:4 lines:["-port: 8080","+port: 9090"] -> h1=result
  DiffHunk "Logging" "@@ -12,4 +12,4 @@" =h2 start:12 lines:["-level: debug","-file: /tmp/app.log","+level: warn","+file: /var/log/app.log"] -> h2=result
  DiffHunk "Cache" "@@ -20,3 +20,5 @@" =h3 start:20 lines:["+enabled: true","+ttl: 300"] -> h3=result
  Row between
    Text.muted "Decided {(h1!=\"\"?1:0)+(h2!=\"\"?1:0)+(h3!=\"\"?1:0)} of 3, kept {(h1==\"keep\"?1:0)+(h2==\"keep\"?1:0)+(h3==\"keep\"?1:0)}"
  ActionButton "Apply" primary enabled:=h1!=""&&h2!=""&&h3!="" -> applied=true; kept=(h1=="keep"?1:0)+(h2=="keep"?1:0)+(h3=="keep"?1:0); discarded=3-kept
  if applied
    Receipt "Changes applied" "{kept} kept, {discarded} discarded" tone:good icon:"check"
